hosting_offers_terms_check.name: hosting_offers_terms_check
hosting_offers_terms_check.value: "hosting_offers"."interval" IN ('month', 'year') AND "hosting_offers"."currency" = 'CNY' AND "hosting_offers"."price_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000000 AND "hosting_offers"."grace_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 90 AND "hosting_offers"."retention_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 3650 AND "hosting_offers"."version" > 0

hosting_purchases_state_check.name: hosting_purchases_state_check
hosting_purchases_state_check.value: "hosting_purchases"."status" in ('available', 'bound', 'refund_pending', 'revoked') and (("hosting_purchases"."status" = 'bound' and "hosting_purchases"."deployment_id" is not null) or ("hosting_purchases"."status" <> 'bound' and "hosting_purchases"."deployment_id" is null))

hosting_exits_valid.name: hosting_exits_valid
hosting_exits_valid.value: "hosting_exits"."version">0 and "hosting_exits"."state" in ('requested','stopping','retained','completed') and ("hosting_exits"."retention_days" is null or "hosting_exits"."retention_days" between 1 and 3650)

hosting_incidents_valid.name: hosting_incidents_valid
hosting_incidents_valid.value: "hosting_incidents"."scope" in ('node','deployment','service') and "hosting_incidents"."state" in ('active','resolved') and "hosting_incidents"."severity" in ('warning','critical') and "hosting_incidents"."occurrences">0

hosting_services_validity.name: hosting_services_validity
hosting_services_validity.value: "hosting_services"."periods" between 1 and 1200 and "hosting_services"."version" > 0 and "hosting_services"."grace_days" between 0 and 90 and "hosting_services"."retention_days" between 1 and 3650 and "hosting_services"."source" in ('trial', 'manual', 'paid') and "hosting_services"."interval" in ('month', 'year') and (("hosting_services"."anchor_at" is null and "hosting_services"."expires_at" is null) or ("hosting_services"."anchor_at" is not null and "hosting_services"."expires_at" is not null and "hosting_services"."expires_at" > "hosting_services"."anchor_at"))
